{{Locations|Rock Homeworlds|LRSmap=noship|unique=true}} 

<div style="margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:-5px;">This event is the '''3rd''' step in the process of unlocking the [[The Crystal Cruiser|Crystal Cruiser]] ship and the [[Ancestry]] achievement while using the [[The Rock Cruiser|Rock Cruiser]]. <span style="color:grey">(the Crystal Cruiser can also be unlocked by winning the game with Layout A and B of all ships, not counting the Lanius Cruiser)</span>

:This event usually occurs at a normal beacon but will turn into a quest beacon if you have the Crystal Crew from the Stasis Pod (Ruwen).</div>
<hr style="height:0px; border:none; border-top:1px solid;">


''An ancient device is orbiting within the crystal rings of a nearby gas giant. You can't discern its nature or function, but it seems to have been deactivated for a very long time. Perhaps you can get some scrap from it.''

==[[Hidden Crystal Worlds]]==
''You arrive in a sector not listed in any star charts. Strange crystalline ships dot the horizon. Your companion speaks, "Here we are, my home sector. It has been a long time since others have set foot here, I wonder how you will be received."''
* ''"You have done as you promised and so shall I. The coordinates of my old ship have been forwarded to your navigation system."''
** A [[#Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.

==Quest Marker==
: {{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=noship}}
''You arrive at the coordinates to find a massive Crystalline cruiser docked at a small repair station. You arrange for the ship to be sent back to the Federation base while the station upgrades your hull.''
* You unlock the [[The Crystal Cruiser|Crystal Cruiser]]; you receive {{tooltip|medium|2-4 fuel}} [[Rewards#Fuel|fuel and scrap]], <span style="color:limegreen">Crystal Vengeance</span> [[Augmentations#Crystal Vengeance|augmentation]], and your ship receives <span style="color:limegreen">10 repairs</span>.

==Notes==
This event is called "ROCK_CRYSTAL_BEACON" in the datafiles.

The quest marker event in the Hidden Crystal Worlds is called "CRYSTAL_UNLOCK" in the datafiles.

* The '''1st''' step of unlocking the [[The Crystal Cruiser|Crystal Cruiser]] ship while using the [[The Rock Cruiser|Rock Cruiser]] is finding the [[Augmentations#Damaged_Stasis_Pod|Damaged Stasis Pod]] in a [[Dense asteroid field distress call]] event, and the '''2nd''' step is bringing it to a [[Zoltan research facility]].
** The damaged stasis pod can be found on a distress beacon in any Engi, Pirate, or Rock sector. The Zoltan research facility can be found on a normal beacon in any Engi or Zoltan sector. Finally, the Ancient device can be found on a normal beacon in the Rock Homeworlds. If the sector map doesn't contain the proper sequence, the quest cannot be completed.
** Any Engi sector could potentially contain both the first and second events, leaving only the Ancient device event.
* Any Crystal crewmember can be used for the blue option, however, only the Crystal Crew from the Stasis Pod (Ruwen) will mark the entry beacon as a quest in the Rock Homeworlds sector.
** Therefore, it is possible to enter the Hidden Crystal Worlds by playing with the [[The_Rock_Cruiser#Layout_C|Rock Cruiser Layout C (Tektite)]] or a previously unlocked [[The Crystal Cruiser|Crystal Cruiser]] without completing the whole quest line.
*** HINT: The [[Augmentations#Long-Ranged_Scanners|Long-Ranged Scanners]] mark adjacent beacons as having ships or as having no ship presence. [[Augmentations#Distraction_Buoys|Distraction Buoys]] will postpone the Rebel Fleet by 1 jump, and [[the mercenary]] can delay the Rebels by 2 jumps (or reveal the sector map). It is also possible to receive a map update as a reward in [[:Category:Beacon Map reveal chance|some events]].
* The strength of enemy ships in the Crystal sector corresponds to the Rock Homeworlds sector number.
* When exiting the Crystal sector, a player has no option of choosing the next sector. Instead, the ship is teleported to the next random sector following the Rock Homeworlds sector number. ([https://ftl.fandom.com/wiki/File:Sector_map_after_exiting_the_Hidden_Crystal_Worlds.png sector map])
